name: The Scarab God
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, each opponent loses X life and you scry X, where X is the number of Zombies you control.
{2}{U}{B}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie.
When The Scarab God dies, return it to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.
blocked_sentences: {2}{U}{B}: Exile target creature card from a graveyard. Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie.

needs.what: a copy_permanent except_ key that replaces the copy's creature subtypes rather than adding to them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_permanent's except_ carries add_subtypes, which keeps the copied card's creature types; 'except it's a 4/4 black Zombie' with no 'in addition to its other types' makes the token a Zombie instead of its other creature types (205.1a), and the types override replaces card types only. Same capability as god_pharaoh_s_gift
